scope: Shared budgets verified through real signed-in application and service HTTP. Phase One resource counters use one source definition and audited, locked reconciliation. Separate-target recovery preserves data and access controls.
limits: Local service-hosting scope. Performance acceptance, broader provider and browser workflows, monitoring delivery, object recovery, accessibility, clean setup and handover remain open. Failed load samples remain downloadable. Admission and credential last-use are not billable request counters.
